propositions: LLM gate operations (transition with completion-verification, review-plan, verify-completion) emit no progress signal to stdout/stderr between invocation and final verdict, causing supervisor stall watchdogs with 600s budgets to kill correct long-running operations mid-execution.

Multi-phase gate pipelines contain silent phases (27s prologue for material-assembly/store-hydration, 40s overlap-corpus retrieval) with no instrumentation even at DEBUG log level, representing local compute with no justification in documentation or design records.

Autonomous agent orchestrators cannot distinguish healthy 10+ minute gate calls from hung processes when no output appears for the entire duration, causing work stranded in in_progress state and requiring manual recovery.
ADR 0089 defers a stream-event idle watchdog to async migration but does not block a separate periodic liveness-heartbeat mechanism compatible with existing blocking sync code.
Test suite (test_llm_timeouts.py) affirmatively encodes silence-tolerance as correct behavior, pinning any future progress-emission remedy to purely additive non-truncating output.
